author: Top Gear
description:
This is the new Sanrivatti One, a track-only supercar with an 800hp V10. Which on the face of it is exciting, but not groundbreaking – except this is a supercar you drive lying down… Now that would be a game-changer! To see if it can work, we’ve driven the wild prototype, and tested in on a unique simulator too. But is this project merely an interesting technical exercise, or can it really deliver a new supercar with the world’s most insane driving position?

🚗 Sanrivatti One
🎤 Ollie Marriage
